The '''Femur''' is a [[Weapons#Club|club weapon]] that can be purchased from the [[Adventurer's Guild]] for {{Price|350}} after reaching floor 10 in [[The Mines]]. It is a possible reward for the chest on floor 10 of the Mines if "remixed" mine rewards are selected in the [[Options|Advanced Options]] menu when starting a new game.

==History==
{{History|1.5|Previously unobtainable weapon introduced.<ref name="unimplemented" /> Weapon level increased from 1 to 2, sell price from 50 to 100.}}
{{History|1.6.9|Added to [[Adventurer's Guild]] shop inventory.}}
